buildCommand: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
//rewrites: Built assets are excluded from the SPA catch-all. Otherwise a request for a chunk a deploy has replaced returns index.html with Content-Type text/html, and the browser reports a MIME-type error instead of a plain 404.
//frame-src: Published pages are framed from the API origin, which is set at build time via VITE_API_URL and so cannot be named literally here — hence https: rather than a single host. It governs only what this app may embed; script-src 'self' is what stops anything else choosing the target.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com https://va.vercel-scripts.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https: wss:; frame-src 'self' blob: https:; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
